name: Assumption Cathedral and Monastery of the town-island of Sviyazhsk
description: On a small hilly island where the Volga, Sviyaga and Shchuka rivers meet in Tatarstan, Sviyazhsk was founded in 1551 as the outpost from which Ivan the Terrible launched his campaign against Kazan. Its Assumption Monastery, built in 1555, was a centre of learning and missionary work. Visitors come for its rare, remarkably well-preserved frescoes inside the cathedral.
